title: Filtered Hom factorization for finitely presented internal modules
statement: In the internal-module convention [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], let Y be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, R an arbitrary internal monoid in abelian pro-etale sheaves, D a small filtered diagram of internal R-modules, c its colimit cocone, and P a globally finitely presented R-module. Every homomorphism P→c.pt factors through some D(i). No monicity condition on the diagram or its cocone is needed.

source.place: (Obj) descent paragraph, finite-stage comparisons on pairwise overlaps

proof.text: A regular-module homomorphism is a section of the underlying sheaf at the terminal pro-etale object. The qcqs section theorem makes such sections descend and equality eventual. Forgetting internal module structure preserves colimits.

For finite free modules, take common upper objects for generator lifts, and a filtered wide-span cocone for equality witnesses. This works for the empty finite set because the index category is nonempty.

Choose the given finite free presentation. Descend the map on generators. Its composite with the relation map is zero in the colimit. Eventual equality for the finite relation module gives a later stage where this composite is zero. Descend through the cokernel to obtain the required map and verify its factorization using the cokernel epimorphism.
